title: Pure Paleozoic
summary: Paleozoic is a pure Normal Trap control and Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz archetype where every single Main Deck Paleozoic Trap Card shares the identical graveyard effect: 'Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap). If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.' Chain your Paleozoic GY traps directly to any Trap activation on the field to swarm Level 2 WATER Aqua bodies unaffected by monster effects, then overlay them into Rank 2 Paleozoic Anomalocaris, Paleozoic Opabinia, and Toadally Awesome!

allow.Swap Frog: Level 2 WATER Aqua that pairs with Level 2 WATER Aqua Paleozoics to Xyz Summon Toadally Awesome, Paleozoic Opabinia, or Gigantic Spright!
allow.Lord of the Heavenly Prison: 3000 ATK Rock that reveals itself in hand to protect all your Set Paleozoic Traps from destruction, and Special Summons itself to Set any Normal Trap when a Set Trap is activated!
allow.Absolute King Back Jack: Level 1 Fiend (can be discarded by Paleozoic Dinomischus!) that rearranges the top 3 cards of your Deck and banishes itself on the opponent's turn to Set the top Normal Trap of your Deck!
allow.Transaction Rollback: Normal Trap (can be discarded by Paleozoic Dinomischus or milled by Paleozoic Marrella!) that banishes itself from the GY and pays half your LP to copy the effect of any Normal Trap in your GY!
allow.Rise to Full Height: Normal Trap sent from Deck to GY by Paleozoic Marrella; banishes itself from GY to target a monster so opponent monsters cannot attack except that target (and if you remove that target, opponent cannot attack at all!).
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Paleozoic Normal Trap from your Deck to Set another copy directly to your field that can be activated the same turn.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 2 Aqua monsters—any 2 Paleozoics summoned from the GY are Level 2 WATER Aqua monsters!) that provides omni-negation and steals negated cards!
allow.Gigantic Spright: Rank 2 Xyz made with any two Level 2 Paleozoics that detaches 1 material (sending a Paleozoic back to the GY instead of banishing it!) to summon Swap Frog from the Deck.
allow.Sky Cavalry Centaurea: Rank 2 Xyz made with two Level 2 Paleozoics that bounces any battling monster without targeting and stacks into Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Rank 12 Xyz stacked over Paleozoic Xyz or Sky Cavalry Centaurea after battle.

main: Paleozoic Marrella

Core Normal Trap: sends ANY 1 Trap Card from your Deck to the GY (loading Paleozoic traps, Transaction Rollback, or Rise to Full Height into the GY!); chains from the GY to any Trap activation to Special Summon itself as a Level 2 WATER Aqua unaffected by monster effects.
Paleozoic Dinomischus
Core Normal Trap: targets 1 face-up card on the field, discards 1 card, and banishes that target; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Paleozoic Olenoides
Core Normal Trap: targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field and destroys it; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Paleozoic Canadia
Core Normal Trap: targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and changes it to face-down Defense Position; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Paleozoic Leanchoilia
Normal Trap: targets 1 banished card (such as a banished Paleozoic, Transaction Rollback, or Rise to Full Height!) and returns it to the GY; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Paleozoic Pikaia
Normal Trap: discards 1 'Paleozoic' card from your hand to draw 2 cards; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Paleozoic Hallucigenia
Normal Trap: halves the ATK and DEF of 1 face-up monster on the field until the end of the turn; revives from GY when a Trap is activated.
Swap Frog
Level 2 WATER Aqua that pairs with any revived Paleozoic to immediately Xyz Summon Toadally Awesome, Paleozoic Opabinia, or Paleozoic Cambroraster.
Absolute King Back Jack
Discarded by Paleozoic Dinomischus to stack the top 3 cards of your Deck and Set a Normal Trap during your opponent's turn that can be activated immediately.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
Protects your Set Paleozoic Traps from board wipes and sets any Normal Trap directly from your Deck.
Transaction Rollback
Sent from your Deck to the GY by Paleozoic Marrella or discarded by Dinomischus; banishes itself from GY to copy any Normal Trap in your GY.
Rise to Full Height
Sent from your Deck to the GY by Paleozoic Marrella; banishes itself from your GY to lock your opponent out of declaring attacks for the entire turn!
Trap Trick
Sets Marrella, Dinomischus, Olenoides, or Canadia from your Deck so it can be activated immediately, while Trap Trick's own activation revives a Paleozoic from your GY!
extra: Signature Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz (2 Level 2 monsters): unaffected by other monsters' effects; allows you to activate 'Paleozoic' Trap Cards directly from your HAND; and adds ANY 'Paleozoic' Trap from your Deck to your hand!

Signature Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz boss (3+ Level 2 monsters; 2400 ATK): unaffected by other monsters' effects; excavates the top card of your Deck when a Trap is sent to the GY (adding it if Trap!); and destroys 1 card on the field as a Quick Effect!
Signature Link-2 WATER Aqua: unaffected by other monsters' effects; targets 1 Set card, sends it to the GY, and Sets 1 'Paleozoic' Trap directly from your Deck so it can be activated this turn!
Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 2 WATER Aqua Xyz (made with any 2 revived Level 2 WATER Aqua Paleozoics!) that negates any card/effect and Sets it to your field, then recycles itself when sent to the GY!
Rank 2 Xyz that detaches a Paleozoic (putting it back in the GY instead of banishing it!) to summon Swap Frog from the Deck.
Rank 2 Xyz that bounces an opposing monster without targeting and climbs into AA-ZEUS.
Rank 12 Xyz stacked over your Rank 2 Xyz monsters to wipe the field.
